recovery_campaign.status: no physical fault/restart was injected and no current exact-identity physical recovery receipt is recorded
recovery_campaign.mechanism: none found in the qualification runner/CLI; no physical fault injected
recovery_campaign.note: Canonical coverage has dedicated recovery definitions; definitions are plans, not execution receipts.
recovery_campaign.consumer_issue: The coverage consumer currently compares the recipe tar-package SHA-256 with the Spark agent Debian-package SHA-256. These are different artifact identities; the canonical recovery contract binds agent_build_sha256. A source fix to remove the cross-artifact comparison is pending review. The optional agent package receipt remains an evidence gap; authenticated live binary and build digests match the signed target, so the receipt gap is not established as a campaign blocker.
